scope: Design contracts only; not a second runtime state machine

current_spatial_refinement.treatment: B preferred conditionally; exact caps require final review
current_spatial_refinement.threshold_policy: consume existing source stability/loss events; do not change recognizer timing

authority: Existing application/controller and media/camera owners remain authoritative until an approved migration

transitions.result: identify and acquire current gesture target

transitions.event: tracking loss / layout replacement / overlay input scope
transitions.result: invalidate gesture acquisition; preserve committed session
ready; require fresh target before fist

gallery.geometry: Six stable wrapper regions; animated artwork descendants ignore picking; no new target algorithm or detector thresholds

chapter.first_frame: Actual first decoded frame; never a reveal timer
chapter.completion: Existing real VideoPlayer completion path; never animation length
chapter.cancel: Distinct from completion; preserve permitted Back behavior and release owned operations
chapter.missing_media: Preserve configured 10-second fallback or hold mode; no unconditional timer replacement

overlay.closing: Retarget from current pose; retain background inert until removal
overlay.minimized: One labelled Resume control; no automatic reopen after route/protected-state change
overlay.restoration: Connected actual opener, stable component key, then intentional route fallback
overlay.stale_callback_guard: Animation/request/media generations cannot act on detached views

deferred_functions: No audio application, preference persistence, reset, camera permission, calibration success, generated QR or assistant response in the prototype
reduced_modes: No spatial/scale/stagger/idle motion; immediate or <=80ms opacity; opaque reading materials; semantic media/camera outcomes unchanged
